(def nth
  "Returns the value at the index. get returns nil if index out of
  bounds, nth throws an exception unless not-found is supplied.  nth
  also works for strings, arrays, regex Matchers and Lists, and,
  in O(n) time, for sequences."
  (fn ([coll n]
    (cond
      (not (number? n))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Index argument to nth must be a number"))

      (nil? coll)
      coll

      (implements? IIndexed coll)
      (-nth coll n)

      (array? coll)
      (if (and (< -1 n (.-length coll)))
        (aget coll (int n))
        (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Index out of bounds")))

      (string? coll)
      (if (and (< -1 n (.-length coll)))
        (aget coll (int n))
        (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Index out of bounds")))

      (or (implements? ISeq coll)
          (implements? ISequential coll))
      (if (neg? n)
        (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Index out of bounds"))
        (linear-traversal-nth coll n))

      (native-satisfies? IIndexed coll)
      (-nth coll n)

      :else
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error (str_ "nth not supported on this type "
                          (type->str (type coll)))))))
  ([coll n not-found]
    (cond
      (not (number? n))
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Index argument to nth must be a number."))

      (nil? coll)
      not-found

      (implements? IIndexed coll)
      (-nth coll n not-found)

      (array? coll)
      (if (and (< -1 n (.-length coll)))
        (aget coll (int n))
        not-found)

      (string? coll)
      (if (and (< -1 n (.-length coll)))
        (aget coll (int n))
        not-found)

      (or (implements? ISeq coll)
          (implements? ISequential coll))
      (if (neg? n)
        not-found
        (linear-traversal-nth coll n not-found))

      (native-satisfies? IIndexed coll)
      (-nth coll n not-found)

      :else
      (throw (suss.bootstrap/error (str_ "nth not supported on this type "
                          (type->str (type coll)))))))))
